entries.03117319e4a67fe1: The company, together with 18 subsidiaries and 1 other affiliated company, forms a group that develops, manufactures and sells products across 3 reportable segments: the Piping Systems Business, the Resin Business, and the Water Treatment and Resource Development Business.
